host.description: The network interface address the server will bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' or '127.0.0.1').

port.description: TCP port on which the ecFlow server listens for client connections.

data_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where workflow definitions, logs, and state are stored.

log_level.description: Minimum log level to record (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or FATAL).

log_file.description: Path to the primary log file. Set to empty string ('') to disable file logging.

log_max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of a log file before it is rotated.

log_keep_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

num_workers.description: Number of worker threads to handle concurrent client requests.

http_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for HTTP requests (connect, read, write).

enable_https.description: Enable HTTPS instead of HTTP for secure communication.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (used only if HTTPS is enabled).

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (used only if HTTPS is enabled).

auth_enabled.description: Enable password or token-based authentication for clients.

auth_password_file.description: Path to the file containing username:password:role entries for basic auth.

auth_token_expiry.description: Time (in seconds) after which authentication tokens expire.

allowed_clients.description: List of IP networks allowed to connect. Empty list = allow all clients.

network.description: CIDR notation of the allowed network (e.g., '10.0.0.0/24' or '192.168.1.0/24').

desc.description: Optional human-readable description of the allowed client group.

restart_on_config_change.description: If true, automatically restarts the server when configuration is changed (e.g., via `ecflow_client --reload`).

heartbeat_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between heartbeat messages to detect client health.

debug_endpoints.description: Enable internal debug HTTP endpoints (e.g., /debug/vars, /debug/pprof) — not for production.

smtp_enabled.description: Enable SMTP for sending email alerts on workflow events (failures, completions, etc.).

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address (used only if SMTP is enabled).

smtp_from_addr.description: Sender email address used in alert notifications.

smtp_use_tls.description: Use STARTTLS to secure the SMTP connection (true recommended).

smtp_username.description: SMTP authentication username (leave empty if not using auth).

admin_emails.description: List of email addresses to receive administrative alerts.

items.description: Email address of an admin to notify.

failover.description: Enable failover mode for high-availability (requires a paired failover peer).

failover_peer_host.description: Hostname or IP of the failover peer server (used only if failover is enabled).

failover_peer_port.description: Port of the failover peer server (used only if failover is enabled).
